data-management.title: Health Facility Optimization using AccessMod and QGIS
data-management.cover-photo-alt: QGIS map showing health facilities in Bunyoro region
data-management.body: The 2024 Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) network optimization report highlights Uganda's bold efforts to improve access to maternal and newborn care, as well as general health services. The aim of this approach is to optimize the number and locations of health facilities providing essential and complicated maternal and newborn care in order to improve the availability and quality of care and ensure a good geographic access of the population within 1 hour of travel time. Health facility data, Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and a WHO geographic access tool (AccessMod) were utilized to guide the optimization of EmONC in the country. This approach will ensure that a significant portion of the population can access equitable, life-saving services. This initiative aligns with Uganda's Vision 2040 and National Development Plan III, which emphasizes leveraging technology and promoting regional integration to enhance health outcomes.

data-management.title: National Safe Motherhood Scientific Repository
data-management.cover-photo-alt: Slide for the National Safe Motherhood Scientific Repository
data-management.body: National Safe Motherhood Repository is a scientific digital repository designed to curate, preserve, and disseminate evidence and knowledge related to maternal, newborn, and reproductive health. Built on InvenioRDM, the repository adopts international best practices for research data management, open science, and long-term digital preservation. The repository is self-hosted, providing full institutional control over data governance, security, customization, and compliance with national policies. This deployment model ensures sustainability and flexibility while supporting integration with local authentication systems and infrastructure. By centralizing safe motherhood evidence in a trusted national platform, the repository strengthens knowledge sharing, promotes transparency, and supports evidence-informed decision-making to improve maternal and newborn health outcomes.
data-management.roles: Backend Developer, Data Visualization, Database Management

data-management.title: Bottle Neck Analysis on PPH Prevention and Management
data-management.cover-photo-alt: Key persons disscussing the  potential bottlenecks
data-management.body: PPH is responsible for 40% of maternal deaths in 2022/23 despite WHO recommendations for life-saving interventions like heat-stable carbetocin (HSC), tranexamic acid (TXA), and misoprostol, access to these medicines remains limited, especially at primary and community levels. The SafeBirth Africa (SBA) initiative, in collaboration with global health agencies and Ugandan authorities, aims to address these gaps by supporting the scale-up of updated PPH protocols. The study sought insights from healthcare providers and stakeholders in Kampala, Jinja, and the Ministry of Health to identify key bottlenecks, their root causes, and potential solutions.
data-management.roles: Data Collection, Data Preparation, Data Analysis, Data Visualization

data-management.title: Mapping tool for use of New Reproductive Health (NRH) commodities
data-management.cover-photo-alt: Blurred image of a workshop with participants
data-management.body: The Ministry of Health has approved the introduction and scale-up of new reproductive health (RH) commodities to enhance maternal health care in Uganda. These commodities have been integrated into key national health documents. To support the effective use of these commodities, the Ministry’s Reproductive and Child Health Department a national training to develop a network of trainers for further scale-up. The mapping exercise aimed to identify health workers eligible for training in the use of these new RH commodities.
data-management.roles: Data Collection, Data Preparation, Data Analysis

data-management.title: Geospatial mapping of Health Facilities
data-management.cover-photo-alt: GIS map showing rural facilities, motorways and primary roads in Central Uganda
data-management.body: Utilized real-time data from representatives in LMNS Regions to assess geospatial accessibility of health services. Employed Accessmod to compute travel scenarios and zonal statistics, which were then visualized using QGIS. This approach offers a significant advantage by calculating accessibility based on actual barriers such as road speed, land cover, and elevation, rather than relying on straight-line distances or circular buffer zones.
data-management.roles: Travel scenarios, Zonal statistics, Data Integration, Capacity Building

data-management.title: EmONC Data Dashboard
data-management.cover-photo-alt: Dashboard showing facilities in Kampala Metropolitan Region with a selected facility.
data-management.body: The EmONC Assessment Uganda 2023 gathered extensive data that required effective dissemination. Tableau was utilized to create an interactive dashboard, facilitating access to key parameters and supporting policy review and adjustments by the Ministry of Health and associated facilities.
data-management.roles: Data Visualization, Dashboard Development, Data integration

data-management.title: EmONC Assessment Uganda
data-management.body: Emergency Obstetrics and New-born Care (EmONC) assessment is a data collection exercise carried out every five years organized by the Ministry of Health to collect data about mothers and their new-borns. The assessment sought to learn how all accredited facilities nationwide manage birthing mothers.
data-management.roles: Data Analyst, Oversaw Data Collection (ODK), Provided Technical Support, Conducted Data Cleaning and Standardization

electronics-design.title: Air Filtration System for Mortuary
electronics-design.body: The air filtration system is designed to improve air quality in mortuaries by filtering out harmful particles and pathogens. Using 2 MQ-135 air quality sensors, activated charcoal, and controlled ventilation, it ensures a safer environment for both staff and visitors.

electronics-design.title: Incubator refill system
electronics-design.cover-photo-alt: Components for prototype of incubator refill projec
electronics-design.body: The incubator refill system is designed to monitor critical parameters such as water levels, humidity, and temperature. It automatically refills water and regulates internal conditions to ensure an optimal environment for newborns.

electronics-design.title: Epilepsy Alert System (Prototype)
electronics-design.cover-photo-alt: Components for prototype of epilepsy alert system
electronics-design.body: The Epilepsy Alert System is an innovative prototype designed to assist caretakers in remotely monitoring epilepsy patients. The system measures brain waves, sudden movements, and heart rate to establish threshold values that can predict and alert caretakers of potential epileptic seizures.
electronics-design.roles: Circuit Design, Sensor Integration, Arduino programming, App building

electronics-design.title: Weigh Chair (Prototype)
electronics-design.body: The Weight Chair is an innovative prototype designed to assist in monitoring and managing weight-related health metrics of disabled patients. This project integrates advanced sensors and microcontrollers to provide real-time data and analytics, ensuring accurate and efficient weight tracking.
electronics-design.roles: Circuit Design, Sensor integration, Arduino Programming
